observed.south.png: Front view of the mummified animal crouched low. A long pale beaked skull with swept-back crest blades points at the camera. observed.east.png: Side profile of the same animal lying collapsed. Limbs are folded forward beneath a long, lean body with an open ribcage. The neck rises to a crested, beaked skull with an eye socket, and a dried, sagging sac hangs under the throat. The long thin tail coils down and back. Feet end in clustered dark pads.
observed.north.png: View of the back: a central spine ridge with faint ribs and hip muscle either side.
